literal: MCP tools/list request sent over the network to the running MCP server
equivalent: MCP tools listed in process against the pinned MCP server module (fastmcp in-memory client)
reason: the pinned MCP server is not part of the upstream compose stack and its HTTP endpoint requires a frontend OAuth token, which the harness has no way to obtain without the interactive web login

literal: raw-schema arm SQL executed on the live Postgres (Source A) and DuckDB (Source B) sources
equivalent: raw-schema arm SQL executed on an in-memory SQLite copy of the fixture, loaded from the same seed files, with Source A as schema a and Source B as schema b
reason: the two live sources are separate engines, so one model-written query cannot join across them; a single SQLite copy holding both sources lets the raw-schema arm answer every question, including cross-source ones, with one query, and is the same engine the reference SQL ground truths were computed on
